claude-cli.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool developed by Anthropic.

latest_news.title: Claude Code 2.x adds subagents, Skills and Hooks, and can connect to MCP tools.
The desktop app supports MCP connectors and local file access on both Windows and macOS.

antigravity.description: Google's agentic coding CLI, command name is agy.

latest_news.title: Google's VS Code-based AI IDE, scheduling multiple tasks in parallel from an agent manager.

workbuddy.description: AI assistant and automation workbench integrating multi-source skills and MCP capabilities.

codex.description: OpenAI's open-source lightweight terminal coding agent that can edit files, run commands locally, and integrate into your workflow.

opencode.description: Open-source AI coding agent by SST, usable in the terminal, desktop, or IDE, supporting 75+ models.

grok.description: A terminal AI coding agent by xAI with a full-screen TUI; it understands codebases, performs edits and runs commands, and searches the web.

deepseek-harness.description: DeepSeek official AI Harness framework and Web service.

openclaw.description: Multi-channel AI gateway with extensible message integrations.

hermes.description: Open-source autonomous AI agent by Nous Research, featuring persistent memory and custom skill creation.

cursor.description: AI-native code editor built on VS Code, supporting repo-wide context editing.

lm-studio.description: Desktop model browser and inference GUI with GGUF support.

trae-cn.description: AI-native IDE from ByteDance (China edition), optimized for Chinese developers with Doubao and DeepSeek.
